units: Percent of US GDP; surpluses positive, deficits negative.
coverage: US current account (calendar year) and federal budget (fiscal-year balance divided by annual GDP).
cache_method: Preserve values plotted in the existing native vector PDF. The World Bank API timed out twice, so no source refresh or extra years were introduced.
recovery: Read the two 55-vertex stroked line paths (navy and coral) with pypdf ContentStream. Consecutive vertices are annual observations 1970–2024. Convert ordinate y via (y - zero)/points_per_percentage_point; round to six decimals. This uses vector coordinates, not raster digitization.
precision: Rounding of original PDF coordinates gives deviations below 0.000001 percentage point; cached observations are for reproducing the original visual, not new statistical estimates.
validation: The final federal-budget value agrees with FRED 2024 -6.19625% to within 0.00001 percentage point.
display: Paired bars, not stacked, because the two balances are not additive.
refresh_command: python -c "import figures_s3 as f; f.refresh_twin_deficits(); f.us_twin_deficits()"
